summarize_session_search: summarize past conversation sessions by keyword query using FTS5 search and LLM-generated summaries
search_recent_sessions: search recent session metadata including titles, previews, and timestamps without LLM cost
search_filtered_sessions: search past sessions with role filter to restrict results to specific message roles like user or assistant
search_with_limit: search past sessions and limit the number of summarized results returned
check_session_requirements: check whether session search prerequisites like SQLite state database and auxiliary model are available
